ask_for_help.definition: To say out loud that you need it. It is not the same as complaining.
ask_for_help.example: I asked for help and she came straight away.

cs_competence_shaming.definition: Raising your own standing by showing that another person cannot do the work.
cs_competence_shaming.example: It was competence shaming: a real error became the reason to put her down in front of the team.

mia_whataboutism.definition: The turning of an answer into an answer about somebody else.
mia_whataboutism.example: You did the same thing last year is whataboutism: it answers nothing.

spec_bias.definition: A habit of attention that leans one way, often without the person noticing.
spec_bias.example: The bias is not against the customer; it is away from the customer.

workaround.definition: A way of working around a problem instead of fixing its cause.
workaround.example: The manual workaround is for us to check the total by hand every Friday.
